title: Teen Gets Rejected by His Crush, His Revenge Is Absolutely Terrifying
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On September 2, 2022, police responded to a report of an attack at a residence in Onalaska, WI. A male suspect had unlawfully entered a female's home and confronted her after she discovered his secret obsession with her. After a few hours, police located the suspect and employed appropriate measures to safely subdue and arrest him, despite his intentions. 

► Storytelling Channel:
https://www.youtube.com/@Beneath_The_Badge 

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
